name: 60016 · Des Plaines, IL
findings: ZIP 60016 (Des Plaines) has 174 nonprofit organizations. 78 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60016 (Des Plaines) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
